title: Extract shared SimpleFin fetch module
outcome: The SimpleFin fetch-and-group logic currently inline in the m1 dashboard's Server Component is extracted into a shared, server-only module (e.g. lib/simplefin.ts) that both the existing page and the future MCP route (m2-002) can call. No behavior change to the dashboard.
acceptance: A new server-only module exports a function (e.g. getBalances()) that reads SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL, calls SimpleFin's /accounts endpoint, and returns the same grouped-by-institution data shape the dashboard currently renders -- including its existing error handling for missing env var and upstream failures (as thrown errors or a discriminated result type; either is fine as long as the page's existing error states still work).
The dashboard's Server Component is updated to call this shared function instead of fetching inline -- its rendered output and error states are unchanged from m1's behavior.
The module is marked/kept server-only (e.g. via the 'server-only' package or by construction) so it cannot accidentally be imported into client code.
All of m1's existing tests still pass unmodified in intent (adjust imports/mocks as needed for the refactor, but do not weaken what they assert).
No new tests are strictly required for this task since it's a pure refactor, but do not remove m1's credential-leak or error-state test coverage.
The repository's required verification command (./scripts/verify-task.sh) passes.
No MCP route or new env vars in this task -- that is m2-002's scope.
